name: Scrap and trim loss review
summary: Each week or month the plant manager gets one review of the material recorded as scrap and trim, by product, machine, shift and reason, with a balance for each completed order, every place the records disagree, and improvement questions. It states no cause the records do not show.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own published map of the work of reviewing scrap and trim loss in a plant, and its own rules for prepared work: stated column headers with a stop when one does not match, blanks and other units never filled or converted, records that disagree put as questions to the person who keeps them, no cause stated, and a person who decides what to investigate.
